name: geospace_fy2021q3_rental_revenue
quote: Rental revenue for the three and nine months ended June 30, 2021 was $5.4 million

flags.note: Rental revenue is a component of revenue, not one of the four first-version metrics.

assumptions.statement: Of the two periods named, the first figure belongs to the three months ended June 30, 2021 ("respectively")
The fiscal year ends on September 30, so the quarter ended June 30, 2021 is the third quarter of fiscal 2021
